raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Clamped nodes at the left end",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The cantilever description identifies the fixed end, but the exact set of constrained mesh nodes is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix both displacement components at every node on the left edge.",
        "Fix both displacement components at the upper-left and lower-left corner nodes."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.2 and Fig. 1a caption describe a cantilever; Fig. 1a has no support-node markings."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Reference direction for the load angle",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The interval [0, π] is specified, but the figure does not label which endpoint of the angular fan corresponds to zero.",
      "readings": [
        "Assign angle 0 to the upper vertical limit of the fan and angle π to the lower limit.",
        "Assign angle 0 to the lower vertical limit of the fan and angle π to the upper limit."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.2 and Fig. 1a caption specify the angular interval; Fig. 1a shows an unlabeled angular fan."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Point-load magnitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No magnitude or normalization is supplied for the single point load.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a constant load magnitude of 1 in consistent units.",
        "Use a constant load magnitude of 2 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.2 and Fig. 1a caption specify load position and angular distribution; Sec. 5.3 mentions load components without specifying their norm."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Density threshold α",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The common threshold for the global and local density constraints is not assigned a numerical value.",
      "readings": [
        "Set α = 0.4 in both constraints.",
        "Set α = 0.5 in both constraints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2, formulation (TO), defines both constraints using α; Appendix Algorithm 2 lists α as an input without giving its Case 1 value."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Local-density averaging radius R_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The radius defining the local-volume neighborhoods is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Use R_e = 6 mesh spacings for every element.",
        "Use R_e = 10 mesh spacings for every element."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 defines the local-density neighborhood using R_e; Appendix Algorithm 2 lists R_e as an input, but Sec. 5.2 supplies no value."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid material's elastic modulus is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Use E = 1 in consistent normalized units.",
        "Use E = 2 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 introduces the linear stiffness matrix K without numerical elastic properties; Sec. 5.2 provides no material values."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for the isotropic elastic reconstruction.",
      "readings": [
        "Use ν = 0.25.",
        "Use ν = 0.30."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 discusses linear elasticity and K; neither that section nor the Case 1 setup in Sec. 5.2 specifies ν."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The structure is described as two-dimensional without specifying plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use plane-stress elasticity.",
        "Use plane-strain elasticity."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.2 identifies Case 1 as a 2D structure; Sec. 3.2 does not define the corresponding constitutive reduction."
    }
  ]
}
